Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement STEP-004: Global Exception Handler Middleware - Core

Introduces GlobalExceptionMiddleware that catches all unhandled exceptions
and returns consistent API responses in ApiResponseEnvelope format.

Key Features:
- Maps exceptions to appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 499, 502, 500)
- Handles all domain exception types (ValidationException, NotFoundException, ForbiddenException, ConflictException, BusinessRuleException)
- Handles standard .NET exceptions (UnauthorizedAccessException, OperationCanceledException, RemoteServiceException)
- Includes TraceId from Activity/HttpContext in all error responses
- Logs exceptions with full stack trace at Error level
- Sets appropriate error levels (Info for 2xx, Warning for 4xx, Error for 5xx)
- Returns JSON content type for all responses

Deliverables:
- GlobalExceptionMiddleware.cs: Core middleware implementation with exception mapping
- GlobalExceptionMiddlewareTests.cs: Comprehensive test suite with 14 tests
  - Tests for each exception type (ValidationException, Unauthorized, Forbidden, NotFound, Conflict, OperationCancelled, RemoteService, Generic)
  - Tests for TraceId inclusion, ContentType, PassThrough, and ErrorLevel determination
  - All tests verify correct HTTP status codes and error response format

Test Coverage:
- Exception mapping for all supported exception types
- HTTP status code verification
- TraceId inclusion and propagation
- Error level determination based on status code
- Successful request pass-through
